name: Poster Redesign Project
description: I found this flyer from a high school peer in my front entranceway, which ws not only slightly trampled but more improtantly poorly designed. I talked to him about a redesign, and sold the new poster design to him for $20. This was my first client project! I wanted to create a vintage and paramilitary feel to the poster, so I used earthy colors and grunge effects. I am happy with how it turned out! There are now 150 copies of the poster soon to be distributed throughout the neighborhood. I am proud of the typography of 'Knoblauch' and 'Landscaping'!
